submitted.rationale: Index 1 (Sb 0.243) had the highest measured EQE, 0.00118%. Response is very weak across the whole line and rises toward the Zn-rich end. XRD looks rutile-like at all three scanned compositions (closest match: trirutile ZnSb2O6, similarity 0.63), and MEGNet predicts a gap near 2 eV.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE about 0 (-0.0001%) near ZnSb2O6 stoichiometry
GP-suggested mid-line point, not measured; its GP mean (0.0005%) was below index 1's measured value

consultations.verdict: Support: MEGNet HSE gap of trirutile ZnSb2O6 (mp-3188) is 1.97 eV, below the 2.4 eV photon energy, so it could absorb. Index 17 is close to ZnSb2O6 stoichiometry, and its XRD matches mp-3188 best. Sb3+ ZnSb2O4 (4.2 eV) would not absorb.

Mild support: spinel Zn7Sb2O12 is near the hull per MACE (0.012 eV/atom), and MEGNet puts its gap at 1.95 eV. It could absorb at 2.4 eV. The Sb-rich end (idx 17) gave about zero, so the next most informative point is the Zn-rich end.

Support: the other Zn7Sb2O12 polymorph (mp-1215862) also has a MEGNet HSE gap of 2.08 eV, below 2.4 eV. Index 0 is closest to the Zn7Sb2O12 stoichiometry (Sb 0.226 vs 0.222), and the measured EQE rises toward the Zn-rich end.
